+## Summary
+
+Raises the pricing cache TTL from 15 minutes to 1 hour to reduce feed request frequency and improve system stability during high-load periods.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Increased `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 seconds (15 min → 1 hour)
+- Removed unused `lookup()` function that was no longer called
+
+## Rationale
+
+A longer cache window reduces the number of pricing feed requests, lowering downstream service load and improving resilience to transient failures. The 1-hour TTL provides a reasonable balance between data freshness and system efficiency for typical pricing workflows.
+
+## Testing
+
+- Verify pricing data remains current under normal conditions
+- Confirm no regressions in pricing accuracy or edge cases
